parsed.summary: Router r2 acts as a gateway between the client segment (10.0.1.0/24) and the server segment (10.0.2.0/24), while also providing connectivity to the management segment (10.0.99.0/24) and facilitating communication with r3 via the link-to-r3 interface. It routes traffic to remote segments through static routes, enabling inter-segment communication in the lab network.

interfaces.role: gateway for the client segment via link to r1

route traffic from the dmz segment through r1
route traffic from the sensors segment through r3
